I picked up one of these for ~$55 during the eBay 20% off sale. When it put it in my Strike Industries enhanced buffer tube, it made a weird “chattering” sound (think fork across a cheese grater). It turned out that the buffer tube had thousands of little ridges from the manufacturing process where it had been bored out.

I took a brake cylinder hone (which you can pick up from any auto parts store or even Harbor Freight if you’re only going to use it once) and polished out all of the tool marks inside the buffer tube.
